description.value: Established in 1988, the Jingle Pot Pub is a cozy, rustic neighbourhood pub situated in one of Nanaimo's most historically rich areas. It offers a full kitchen menu, a seasonal outdoor patio surrounded by a flower garden, and regular live music performances. Touring cyclists rolling through the Jingle Pot Road corridor will find it a welcoming stop for a meal and cold drink in a genuine local atmosphere.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at thejinglepotpub.com is fully accessible and confirms all OSM contact details (address, phone, email) exactly. The site describes a full-service pub with kitchen, patio, and live entertainment, established 1988, but contains no mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, takeout, or any cycling-specific amenities. OSM tags provide no additional amenity data beyond address/phone/hours.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible pub with a confirmed website, matching contact details, and current content including seasonal patio announcements and upcoming entertainment listings.
